route: Google-owned googleanalytics/google-analytics-mcp, release 1.1.0; local Python MCP or customer-deployed HTTP server
read: Account/property discovery, Ads links, annotations, key events, custom dimensions/metrics, core/funnel/conversions/realtime reports.
write: Opt-in creation of property annotations, custom dimensions and key events. No general update/delete/property administration tool is documented in the current MCP catalogue.
setupDetails: Install Python/pipx, enable Analytics Admin and Data APIs, configure Google credentials and the MCP client. Remote HTTP/OAuth and Docker/Cloud Run are self-deployment options, not a Google-hosted connector.
access: Read access follows Analytics account permissions. Writes default off; require --allow-write plus analytics.edit. Custom dimensions require Editor; key events require Marketer or Editor.
limitations: Three creation operations are not general Admin API CRUD.
The user must operate the local server or deploy/maintain an HTTP service.

route: Stape's third-party hosted Google Tag Manager MCP at https://gtm-mcp.stape.io/mcp; not Google-owned

setupDetails: Add a custom remote connector and sign in with Google OAuth. Maintainer documents direct Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and coding-client connections. Optional local CLI uses supplied credentials.
access: Google account must have the relevant GTM permissions, particularly publish rights. Hosted traffic passes through Stape; local CLI is an alternative. AI workspace policy can restrict custom connectors.
limitations: This is a third-party route and must be labelled as such.
Publishing a container does not establish correct tracking, consent or website installation; test those separately.
Hosted commercial limits were not established in this review.
